Subject: Request: trial extension + onboarding credits for BrightApp POC

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency and cost controls. We pushed a small POC last Friday and burned through the starting trial much faster than expected due to extensive evals across embeddings and chat flows.

We have procurement kicking off next week and I'd like to keep momentum. If helpful, I can share the POC scope and a short timeline (2–3 weeks). Happy to sign a short terms addendum.

Best,
Oliver Chen
Head of AI, BrightApp
oliver@brightapp.com

Short answer: yes, we can do a one-off credit issuance for PLG signups in cases like this. I need to coordinate a quick ops approval and generate a single-use promo code. A few details I need to confirm so Marissa and I can process it:

- Exact credit amount you're requesting (you suggested $1,500)
- Desired expiration window for the code (default is 30 days; we can extend to 60 for procurement cycles)
